notes.title: Client and Server Update 1.1.28
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce a new client and server update. 

This time the list is very brief, mainly because we focused on bringing you one single, long-deserved update: Base Station Conquering.

Here's the list of changes and bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Added STATION CONQUERING!!!
[*] Added Container filter in Navigation Screen
[*] Fixed a bug with ingame Bug Reporting tool not working properly
[/list]

Thank you for all your support. 

Sail safe!

notes.title: Client Update 1.1.23
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce a new client update. 

This is mostly a maintenance release.

Here's the list of changes and bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Added some details to Agent Status
[*] Gate animation was changed to prevent unwanted visual effects
[*] Fixed a bug with disappearing Reference Boxes when switching Ship
[*] Fixed a bug with Hunt task and Ships without weapons
[*] Fixed a bug with Holding Panel mistakenly showing no holding information

notes.title: Client and Server Update 1.1.21
notes.notes:
We want to wish everyone a merry Christmas, and announce a new client and server update.

And we have a big present for everyone: Hunting is here!!! You can finally send your ships around the galaxy, seeking enemies and engaging in battles, leaving everything in the hands of your Agents.

Here's the list of changes and bug fixes: 

[list]
[*] Automatic hunting! The order is available through Management Panel, or from Navigation Window when selecting a Waypoint. More information available on the wiki.
[*] Added information about Agent manning requirements in trade window.
[*] Added an option to turn off the chat, useful if you want to connect through IRC to avoid hiccups in the client, or just playing without showing up in chat.
[*] Fixed a bug with Pink Lightsabers appearing on Gates. No more Lightsabers. But Star Wars VII is out, if you want.
[*] Fixed a bug where default quantity was wrong on refining screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where it was possible to open an empty ticket from the client.
[*] Fixed a bug where no error was shown when the Ship Cargo was full.
[*] Fixed a bug where Attack and/or Healing were not correctly shown on Reference Boxes.
[*] Fixed a bug with wrong target showing up in Order Screen in Management Panel.
[*] Fixed a bug on iOS where some assets were missing.
[*] Fixed a bug on iOS and Android where deleting some text would break the interface.
[/list]

In the next patch we will add a way to reclaim abandoned Base Stations, and this will be the first step toward conquering them. Il will take a while to be completed, but be patient and stay tuned, we're on it.

Thank you for all your support and patience. 

Sail safe!

notes.title: Client and Server Update 1.1.19
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce a new client and server update.

This is mainly a maintenance release, solving bugs and adding small features.

We also worked on the server engine to add some "backstage" features that will help us in adding the Patrol (Auto-hunt) order and to make stations conquerable in the next future releases. Yes, we're still planning to bring these features in the game within this year, as we announced :-)

Here's the list of changes and bug fixes: 

[list]
[*] enemies NPCs can (and will) now be spawned in fleets
[*] Standings now include the Holding modifier, showing the ones actually being used by the game server
[*] in Hire Agent Screen, there is now a very brief description for each Agent Stat
[*] in Hire Agent Screen, "-" and "+" buttons for Stats are now disabled when reaching min/max value
[*] in Mail Screen, there is now a "DELETE ALL" button
[*] on mobile devices, the view rotates 180 degrees when rotating the device
[*] added a new Deep Scan when taking control of a Ship
[*] "Profanity Filter" option label is (finally) more clear, changing into "Profanity Filter for PM"
[*] Throttle bar no longer goes under 1%, as initially intended
[*] Planets texture is now a bit more light, to limit the "dark planets" effect
[*] Fixed a bug with some Fleet Ships having NaN distance
[*] Fixed a bug on mobile devices where the transfer popup did not allow to manually input a quantity
[*] Fixed a bug where links in chat disappeared with the wrong speed
[*] Fixed a bug with reference box not disappearing when needed
[*] Fixed a bug where attacks did not land when fighting distance was around 12Km
[*] Fixed a bug with combat music switching off too soon
[*] Fixed a bug with warp out animation for other Ships not being always triggered
[/list]

We will continue working on the remaining bugs, while we also work on adding low- and high-level Events as promised.

Thank you for all your support and patience. 

Sail safe!

notes.title: Client and Server Update 1.1.12
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce a new client and server update.

In this release we again focused on fixing some annoying bugs and implementing some small features that have been sitting in our todo list for too much time.

We've also added a new set of 20 agent portraits, and took the chance to polish them all a bit.

Last but not least, we finally added a second, cruiser-level event. It will probably need some tuning, but it should already be enjoyable. Look out for L.A.W. Ambush Sites in Hobert, Liriam and Zarius.

Here's the list of changes and bug fixes: 

[list]
[*] added 20 brand new Agent portraits
[*] added a Universal Time clock in Management Screen
[*] URL are now clickable in chat, and will open an external browser
[*] Base Station's owner is now shown in Station Screen and in the informative popup in Navigation Screen
[*] added a red flashing indicator while throttling in Navigation Screen
[*] aggro on enemy ships is now cleared after some time
[*] Reference Boxes will now automatically appear when the appropriate filter is selected and new ships come into sight
[*] when Free Look is on, camera will go back to selected position after a gate or jump animation
[*] System Map default zoom and angle slightly changed to avoid having markers outside of the screen at certain resolutions
[*] when the range slider is set at 20Km, interactive commands are now disabled to make clear that they would not work
[*] Fixed a bug where A.I. would sometimes keep a target gone outside visibility range and fail to switch attacking visible targets
[*] Fixed a bug where Leadership XP would overflow if two ships in the same fleet killed two different enemy ships in the same moment
[*] Fixed a bug where some L.A.W. ships laser animations could start from random points in the space
[*] Fixed a bug on iOS and Android where chat elements and map buttons could overlap
[*] Fixed a bug where in some case refining very small ore quantities for free could possible
[*] Fixed a bug where zooming out (a lot) could break UI
[*] Fixed a bug where switching between ships with interactive components turned on could initially not show interactive effect
[/list]

We will continue working on the remaining bugs, while we also work on adding low- and high-level Events as promised.

Thank you for all your support and patience. 

Sail safe!

notes.title: Client and Server Update 1.1.5
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce a new client and server update.

With this release, we have fixed tons of bugs that were left behind while we were working on many features. Some of them are actual bug fixes, while some others led us to make small changes to prevent dangerous situations. We also made some U.I. adjustments.

And (drumroll, please)... We're releasing our first iOS version of Gates of Horizon on the Apple Store. It should be considered a test version, it still needs some heavy work, but we're releasing it today. First release version will be 1.1.1, while 1.1.5 will follow very soon.

Here's the list of changes and bug fixes: 

[list]
[*] iOS application will be released today on the Apple Store.
[*] added some new loot to the final Event boss
[*] A.I. assist / defend behavior and priorities are now better defined and are different in the two profiles. Check the Wiki for all the details.
[*] it is no longer possible to set throttle to zero. Minimum value is now 1%. To completely stop a ship, the stop button must be used.
[*] Ship Dismantle now automatically take care of Components and Cargo content, and will give a warning if a Ship is still in a Fleet before starting the process
[*] Ships in fleet are now always considered visible
[*] Planetary Base Stations will now be automatically positioned upon creation
[*] agent list in Trade Screen will now be refreshed when switching between traders
[*] added a limit of 400 characters to Chat input box
[*] added a limit of 250 members to Holdings
[*] "Armor Repair" value was added to Ship Details screen
[*] System Map and Star Map 2D/3D setting will now be remembered
[*] Entity Info popup is now draggable
[*] Mail Notifications will be disabled during Tutorial to avoid confusing players
[*] fixed a bug where Harvest order would not correctly stop from the Order Screen, in Management Panel
[*] fixed a bug where a Holding could end up without a valid CEO
[*] fixed a bug where a wrong default Cargo Transfer quantity could be applied
[*] fixed a bug where A.I. icon would not appear for some fleet ships
[*] fixed a bug where A.I. would use the wrong command while trying to assist fleet ships, preventing it from completing the action
[*] fixed a bug where Fleet Commands would appear in Command Hexagon even when a Corporation had no other ships in fleet
[*] fixed a bug where the Command Hexagon would appear outside screen in System Map or Star Map
[*] fixed a bug where random transfers could start in Holding Cargo after an incomplete drag'n'drop action
[*] fixed a bug where Fleet Commands could receive the click event instead of the normal Commands in the Command Hexagon
[*] fixed a misleading error "Component Invalid" when trying to re-embark
[*] fixed a bug where, upon typing a wrong password, a stale connection to the server remained open slowing the client down
[*] fixed Deep Scan animation and yellow markers appearing in System Map while navigating another System.
[*] fixed a "Corporation Not Valid" error appearing during Tutorial
[*] fixed a bug where the Cargo Popup in Navigation Screen had a draggable area way too big
[*] fixed some rare bugs that that could cause a System Server to crash
[/list]

We will continue working on the remaining bugs, while we also work on adding low- and high-level Events as promised.

Thank you for all your support and patience. 

Sail safe!

notes.title: Client Update: 1.1.0
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce the first Gates of Horizon major client and server release.

With this release, we are adding everything we need to create interactive Events in the universe! This is just a start, but a very exciting and promising one.

At the moment, you can find a high-level Event in Grossil, Muvor and Sinol. This is intended both as a tuning test for future Events, and as the first of our end-game contents.

In the next weeks, we will add low- and high-level Events, disclosing some more details about Gates of Horizon Lore and giving players some more chances to enjoy the game in new and fun ways.

Here's the list of changes and bug fixes: 

[list]
[*] Events!!! If you're brave, check the Distress Signal in Grossil, Muvor and Sinol.
[*] Steam Cards are now out!
[*] Deep Scan button in Navigation Screen now works as a modifier toggle button, extending the selected filter's range to Deep Scan range.
[*] new option added: "Apply limit to Deep Scan ref boxes" will apply the "Max Ref Boxes" limit to Deep Scan Reference Boxes too. Option is active by default.
[*] added Undock command to the Command Hexagon, for fleet members.
[*] added Harvest command to the Command Hexagon. Target a Base Station where you want to drop your ores, from Navigation Screen, System Map, or Star Map.
[*] split Market Search button in "Search (you buy)" and "Search (you sell)" to improve sell/buy selector visibility.
[*] added a Stats Sum indicator in the Hire Agent screen, to help with Stats sum.
[*] added a cinematic announce when entering a system.
[*] fixed a bug where ships with A.I. turned on would only assist ships firing to a target, but not ships getting hit. Thus, a ship with no weapons would never receive assistance.
[*] fixed a bug where a ship could be in fleet when building a Base Station. Now, the ship must correctly leave fleet prior to actually build the Station, as it was intended to.
[*] fixed a bug where A.I. settings were not correctly used for active repairers/rechargers.
[*] fixed a bug in Chat Screen, where sometimes [DEV] chat lines were truncated.
[/list]

We expect, in the next days, to tune the current Event, after getting feedback from first players attempting it, and to quickly add some low-level events in inner systems. We'll keep you posted.

Thank you for all your support and patience. 

Sail safe!

notes.title: Server and Content Update: May 21, 2015
notes.notes:
Greetings,

   we're releasing a maintenance patch that addresses some issues with A.I., hopefully bringing it back to an useable and useful state.
   
We're also updating our System Quest status, with three new systems opening up.
   
Here's a list of what's new:

[list]
[*] The 3 new gates have been successfully aligned, and Alteris, Walan and Davon are now reachable. Please take care while sailing, as heavy Pirate and Alien presence has been detected.
[*] outer neutral systems's asteroid belts now has aliens (instead of pirates) lurking among asteroids
[*] chat system received some improvements, that should make it slightly more resilient to connection drops
[*] skill descriptions have been revised, and should now give some more information
[*] fixed a bug where a ship would sometimes randomly jump 500Km away
[*] fixed a bug where assist would be triggered by attack commands instead of actual weapon shooting
[*] fixed a bug where interactive repairers or rechargers would not interrupt correctly
[*] fixed a bug where a ship docking could sometimes incorrectly turned on A.I. for all fleet's ships
[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: Client Update: 1.0.42
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce a new client and server release.

We finally started IOS closed testing! Write to support@hexkeep.com if you want to participate. IOS 8+ and Testflight is required (for the testing, the final app should run on older system without problems).

We also added an experimental system for granting Faction Standing in Crafting and Manufacturing. At the moment, numbers are willingly very small. We want to collect data, see how the system works, and make small adjustments in the next weeks until we will have a working mechanism. 

Here's the list of changes and bug fixes: 

[list]
[*] Standing shift for Manufacturing: each time you spend money in Manufacturing (Crafting, Refining, Distillation) you will :
    * gain Faction Standing toward Base Station owner's faction
    * if the owner's faction is Hostile or Enemy toward your main Faction, you will lose Faction Standing toward your main Faction and their friendly Faction
[*] Standing shift for Trading: each time you earn money selling goods, you will :
    * gain Faction Standing toward buyer's Faction
    * if the buyer's faction is Hostile or Enemy toward your main Faction, you will lose Faction Standing toward your main Faction and their friendly Faction
[*] IOS version is officially in closed testing. 
[*] fixed a bug where A.I. assist was not working correctly. Now, ships will correctly aid fleet companions in attacking enemies
[*] fixed a bug where using a Remote Recharger, Repairer, or Transferrer in fleet sometime caused other ships to start orbiting around the target
[*] fixed a bug with missing 0 in distances under 1Km
[*] fixed a bug where clicks on some command buttons were incorrectly sent to A.I. toggle button instead.
[*] fixed a bug where clicking on an item in Market Search when Agent is not on Base Station would propose a Shuttle and then give an error
[/list]

From here, we'll start working on Events. This will be probably the last patch for a while, as we expect it to be a very long work. We'll do our best to keep everyone updated on our progress.

Thank you for all your support and patience. 

Sail safe!

notes.title: Client Update: 1.0.37
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce a new client and server release.

Automining is finally here! It's now possible to assign a Harvest order to a ship. Beware of ambushers!

We've also added a new set of hotkeys, to quickly manage fleets and commands.

And there's more! We've released a better set of SFX, you may want to give them a try.

Here's the list of changes and bug fixes: 

[list]
[*] new order: Harvest
    The Harvest order targets the Base Station where you want to collect your minerals.
	Selected ship will travel through asteroids waypoints in that System, mining every asteroid in sight. 
	When cargo is full, it will travel to Base Station, unload everything, and start over.
	Order will stop when Station Corporation Cargo is full.
	Note: Mining Waste Rocks is *not* automatically jettisoned.
[*] new hotkeys
	Q/W/E/R/T are now used for quick attack/mine/remote repair/remote recharge/remote transfer selected target.
	1-7 are used to quickly switch between fleet ships.
	CTRL is used to select a ship where the next order will be applied. I.e.: controlling ship 1, CTRL-2, then Q will make the second fleet ship attack your selected target.
	ESC is used to open/close Management Panel.
	B/N/M are the new keys for Tactical/System/Star maps.
	Keys are customizable from the new "HOTKEYS" tab in Options Window.
[*] new SFX
    We updated our SFX. They should now be a bit better than before.
	Weapons and explosions effects are also different depending on Ship size.
[*] it is now possible to access Corporation Cargo on a Station during navigation, using the Cargo icon in Command Hexagon while being near the Base Station
[*] when an Agent is embarked on a sailing Ship, Market Search, Skill (no modifications) and Blueprint (no modifications) Screens are now accessible from Management Panel
[*] when a Ship is sailing, Fitting (no modifications) and Cargo (no modifications) Screens are now accessible from Management Panel
[*] interactive Components Travel Time were tuned to include skills affecting cooldown times
[*] it is now possible to directly type values in A.I. Options Screen
[*] some FPS-friendly GUI options were added. Turning them off can improve FPS. They are:
	Show Meters: show/hide the three colored bars above targets
	Show Distance: show/hide the distance below targets (NOT the one in Reference Boxes)
	Ships Combatlog: show/hide interactive numbers on targets
	Ref Boxes Combatlog: show/hide interactive numbers on Reference Boxes
[*] an icon to open Chat in Navigation Screen with a click/tap was added
[*] in Crafting Screen, shown resources order is now meaningful
[*] from now on, client will check for an available update each time a login is attempted, instead of checking just once when opened.
[*] client is now built against Unity 4.6.4, bringing in some important fixes
[*] fixed a bug where A.I. was incorrectly turned on when opening Management Screen
[*] fixed a bug where Waypoints weren't appearing as a valid Order target from Order Screen in Management Panel
[*] fixed a bug where an incorrect Standing amount were granted to Holdings Managers
[*] fixed a bug with Holding Deposit dialog showing incorrect numbers on the slider
[*] fixed a bug where quantity was incorrectly not shown in Holding Module Screen when just 1 Module of a specific type was installed
[*] fixed a bug where Order Screen in Management Panel shown a wrong text when changing Order or System
[*] fixed a bug where Mining command incorrectly started with a full Cargo
[*] fixed a bug with Agent Screen in Management Screen incorrectly showing the wrong Agent
[*] fixed a bug where Holding Roles flags were not showing after first assignment
[*] fixed a bug where thousands and decimal separator was missing in some Holding screens in Management Panel
[*] fixed a bug with wrong thousands and decimal separator appearing in Reference Boxes
[/list]

Our next step will be the Autohunt Order, together with some A.I. server code that will be soon used in Events.

Thank you for all your support and patience. 

Sail safe!

notes.title: Client Update 1.0.30
notes.notes:
We just released a quick hotfix to solve a problem with Smugglers, Pirates and Neldai standings.

notes.title: Client Update: 1.0.25
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce a new client and server release.

This is a big step forward in A.I. management: it is now possible to control and clearly see on which fleet ship the A.I. is active, and it is also possible to tune its behavior parameters for each entity.

Here's the list of changes and bug fixes: 

[list]
[*] A.I. management was completely overhauled. 
    It is now possible to turn A.I. ON or OFF for ships and fleet, choosing a level and a profile.
	It is also possible to tune A.I. behavior for each ship from Ship Detail Screen in Management Panel.
	Please refer to the official Wiki for more details: http://wiki.gatesofhorizon.com/Official:A.I.
[*] Fleet Ship order in Navigation Screen is now fixed, and is no longer changing when switching ship control
[*] a Mining Engine was added. This engine can be manned with Mining skill instead of Pilot skill. 
    Alas, the needed piloting automation circuits took away some room needed by aiming modules, resulting in very poor weapons performance.
	Small Engines can be bought from Galumbris Mining Equipment's traders:
    * Lucian Bakosky, on Marianic Base Station, Astonis System
    * Titus Burgman, on Gravis Base Station, Pilos System
    * Felicia Goose, on Yaticus Base Station, Yatis System
	From the same traders it's also possible to learn Small, Medium and Large Blueprints.
[*] embarked Agents are now actively evaluated when calculating enemy strength comparison, shown with icon color, and when calculating Warfare XP. 
    Expect enemies to be shown as easier, and XP gained to be a bit less than before, especially for high-level ships with many embarked high-level agents.
[*] allocated Character Points are now visible in Agent Details Screen
[*] embarked Ship in Agent and Ship Details Screen is now clickable, and leads to Ship Details Screen
[*] Base Station in Agent and Ship Details Screen is now clickable, and leads to Base Station Screen
[*] Manufacture Screen now opens on the last selected panel (Crafting, Refining or Distillation)
[*] default maximum value when moving multiple items is no longer more than the destination cargo available space
[*] Distillation Screen now only shows cargo resources that are actually distillable
[*] Reference Boxes are no longer appearing over the Free Look switch
[*] Cargo occupied space is now shown as a percentage near the Cargo button in Navigation Screen
[*] a Planet filter was added to Navigation Screen
[*] Trader Icon in Star Map and System Map is now only shown when a Corporation Agent has an active Buy or Sell order.
[*] an elusive and cunning memory leak was finally solved in the client, and should bring more stability when running the client for a long time
[*] client is now built against Unity 4.6.3, bringing in some important fixes
[*] fixed a bug where a mining Interactive Component being turned off when Cargo is full was not correctly showing "CARGO FULL" error
[*] fixed a bug with item order messing up in Cargo Popup, in Navigation Screen
[*] fixed a bug in Cargo Popup, in Navigation Screen, where the cargo current and total space numbers were incorrectly truncated
[*] fixed a bug with Ship throttle settings sometimes not being correctly saved when docking
[*] fixed a bug where Base Station building could be prevented in Safe Systems
[*] fixed a bug in Asset and Station screen where Ship position was not correctly updated
[*] fixed a bug in Crafting Screen where needed resources were not shown correctly
[*] fixed a bug in Trade Screen where trader info were not correctly refreshed
[*] fixed a bug in Holding Screen where some numbers were missing thousand separator
[*] fixed a bug in Holding Screen where current Holding Money reported a wrong number
[*] fixed a bug in Buy Order mail notification, where taxes were not correctly reported
[*] fixed a bug where the Mail Notification icon was not correctly blinking when a now notification was available
[*] fixed a bug in Android where list scrolling speed was broken
[/list]

From here, we will proceed to work on Automine and Autohunt Orders, that are right now our top priority.

Thank you for all your support and patience. 

Sail safe!

notes.title: Content Update - Feb 27, 2015
notes.notes:
Greetings,

   we're releasing a content update, addressing some balance issues and updating our System Quest status.
   
Here's a list of what's new:

[list]
[*] New gates needs to be aligned to 3 newfound Hostile Systems: Alteris, Walan and Davon. As usual, System Connecting's traders are willing to buy Radio Beacons from players. You can find: 
* Albert Querel
* Laureen Polerin
* Zoe Markal 
... on Capital Stations. Also, you can find them easily from the market search, looking for Gate Construction Parts. 
After their orders are completely fulfilled, new gates will open within 24-48h.

[*] System Gate Radio Beacons can be crafted. You can learn blueprints from
* Katia Doronkova on Lugren II Base Station
* Aria Melbassi on Xolten Base Station 
* Rafael Massi on Sabrac Base Station

[*] System Gate Radio Beacons can also be found on some Deep Space Pirate ships in many systems.

[*] This time, due to the high alien interferences, System Connecting’s traders also need alien Power Cells. These power cells can be looted from some alien battleships.

[*] Three VERY DANGEROUS Invading Vessels were spotted in Grossil, Sinol and Muvor, within the Alien Invading Fleets. L.A.W. strongly recommends to *stay away* from them. They already destroyed many Battleships fleet with apparent ease. It seems they use some new type of hybrid technology that could be useable from standard ships, and also carry a good number of Power Cells.

[*] Base Station Modules Maintenance costs were completely revised. They are now:
 * Planetary Mining Module: 180'000 credits / hour
 * Manufacture Modules: 5'000 credits / hour
 * Internal / External Defense Modules: 50'000 credits / hour (these are still not used)
 * Cargo Modules does not require maintenance.
Also, Planetary Mining Module efficiency is now reduced to 90'000 tons / hour.

This is a much needed balancing action, as at the moment Planetary Base Stations are WAY too much profitable. They should still be profitable, but our aim is to make them a way for Holdings to control systems and to drive PVP, not just to make Holdings easily rich (even if they will help).
[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: CLIENT UPDATE 1.0.16
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce a new client and server release.

Here's the list of changes and bug fixes: 

[list]
[*] the old Holding Invite Screen is now replaced by a new Notification Mail Screen
[*] automatic notifications are now sent for holding invites, destroyed ships, finished manufacturings, and sold/bought items for traders
[*] Interactive Components can now be deactivated (and re-activated) selectively, [b]after[/b] the interaction is started from the Reference Box. 
[*] A.I. is now behaving as intended, after a big round of bug fixes. Non-controlled ships in a fleet now correctly use repair/recharge/transfer components on fleet members and on themselves when needed. (expect further tuning in next patches)
[*] ranges for ships in a Fleet are now persistent, and no longer reset to default when switching ship
[*] better visibility on selected order in ship Order Screen
[*] damage numbers popping up in Navigation Screen now includes energy and mass resistance, and correctly shows the real applied damage
[*] complimentary cargo on faction Capital Station is now added upon Corporation creation, to avoid new players being stuck with no cargo to buy C.A.A. items.
[*] added coordinates letters/numbers for System Map
[*] fixed a bug where Energy branch skills uncorrectly influenced Deep Scan cooldown
[*] fixed a bug where, after leaving a fleet, XP was not correctly earned
[*] fixed a bug where an ansteroid or ship model depleted / destroyed by a non-controlled ship would be stuck.
[*] fixed a bug when entering a number directly in trade and cargo transfer popups
[*] fixed a bug with Pirate Light Cruiser Morolin-2 not shooting correctly
[*] fixed a bug where "COMPONENT SLOT NOT AVAILABLE" was randomly appearing when entering Fitting Screen
[*] fixed a bug that closed client connection when attempting to put a job on a closed queue
[*] fixed a bug with chat sometimes turning yellow after private communications 
[*] fixed a bug where credits were not updating after a Blueprint Learn
[*] fixed a bug that sometimes prevented ship's repair bar animation to work propery
[*] fixed a bug with chat DEV tag disappearing
[*] fixed a bug where after a /r or /t command, the selected channel were always [G]
[/list]

Thank you for all your support. 

Sail safe!

notes.title: Content Update - Jan 28, 2015
notes.notes:
Greetings,

   we're releasing a content update, addressing some balance issues and updating our System Quest status.
   
Here's a list of what's new:

[list]
[*] The 3 new gates have been successfully aligned, and Zerib, Werten and Lugren are now reachable. Please take care while sailing, as Pirate and Alien presence has been detected.

[*] System Connecting Corp. recently built new Gateways to 3 newfound Systems: Furik, Igani and Obim. As usual, these Gateways require to be aligned, and their traders are willing to buy Radio Beacons from players. You can find 
* Albert Querel
* Laureen Polerin
* Zoe Markal 
... on Capital Stations. Also, you can find them easily from the market search, looking for the new Gadget (Gate Construction Parts). 
After their order will be completely fulfilled, new gates will open within 24-48h.

[*] System Gate Radio Beacons can be crafted. You can learn blueprints from
* Katia Doronkova on Wristral Base Station
* Aria Melbassi on Husil Base Station 
* Rafael Massi on Surimal Base Station

[*] System Gate Radio Beacons can also be found on some Deep Space Pirate ships that we recently added in many systems.

[*] Galumbris Mining Equipment and Ortega Support Equipment have discovered a cooling problem in their laser. As a security measure, cooldown of Medium and Large Mining Lasers have been increased.

[*] "Renewable resources - is extreme mining leading to a global crisis?", a paper submitted to Scientific Universe by Federation Analysts, showed that rarest resources are becoming more uncommon in bigger asteroids.

[*] Due to the increasing crime rate in Hostile Systems, several Corporations have moved their Traders in the new Neutral Systems.
[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: Client Update: 1.0.12
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce a new client and server release. 

Here's the usual list of changes and bug fixes: 

[list]
[*] Station Modules Blueprints can now be learned from trainers
[*] Planets and Moons are now visible in Navigation Screen
[*] Added a thousand separator to improve big numbers readability
[*] Added a message to warn when Game Client was not able to correctly download all assets
[*] When a ship is destroyed being in a fleet, control will switch to next ship
[*] Ships in fleet can now be kicked when docked
[*] Fleet ship number is now correctly limited to 7 (seven), as it was intended
[*] HUD and GUI Opacity cannot be lowered under 10%
[*] CHAT: added /n command for faction channel from Navigation Window
[*] CHAT: added an option to disable Join, Leave and Quit messages
[*] CHAT: Join, Leave and Quit messages are no longer shown when channel or player are ignored
[*] CHAT: Unity Rich Text parsing, not intended to be there, is now stripped
[*] CHAT: fixed a bug where Holding CEO incorrectly shown DEV tag
[*] CHAT: fixed a bug in Navigation Window where channel were reset to "General" after traversing a Gate
[*] CHAT: fixed a bug where scroll bar in Chat Window would cover some long lines
[*] CHAT: fixed a bug where DEV tag would disappear from message after Developer quits
[*] CHAT: fixed a bug where some multiline messages were shown on a single line
[*] fixed a bug where orders were not refreshed in Entity Orders Screen
[*] fixed a bug with Transparency options that was inverted (now called Opacity)
[*] fixed a bug when showing taxes on Buy Announces
[*] fixed a bug in Station Screen with selected ship when undocking a ship
[*] fixed a bug where "CORPORATION NOT VALID" message were appearing when near an unowned ship
[*] fixed a bug in Navigation Window when Cargo Panel didn't correctly show icons
[*] fixed a bug where clicks in Corporation Info window incorrectly passed through
[*] fixed a bug where orbit range didn't grow correctly during orbiting
[*] fixed a bug where dismantling a ship was incorrectly allowed with full cargo
[*] fixed a bug where holding invites were not received
[*] fixed a bug with Deep Scan Enhancer that were not working correctly.
[*] fixed a bug where cargo were incorrectly reserver on manufacturing, causing a wide range of problems
[*] fixed (more than) one typo in Tutorial
[/list]

Next server patch will be an interesting one, including some things like:

[list]
[*] Notification messages for events like destroyed ships, finished manufacturing, or sold/bought item from a trader
[*] Persistent range settings for Ships
[*] Selective deactivation of Interactive components
[*] Active Component that allows scanning for asteroid composition
[*] Android version ready on Play Store
[/list]

Thank you for all your support and patience, we couldn't hope for a better community. You all rock!

notes.title: Client update: 1.0.10
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce a new client release. Here's a list of changes: 

[list]
[*]Chat: it is now possible to mute a channel (from the channel tab in the Chat Screen) or a player (from the Corporation Info window).
[*]Chat: we added a new Faction channel.
[*]Holding member list is now sorted first by rank and then alphabetically.
[*]Fixed a bug during Agent hire operations, where Stats lower value was zero instead of one.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Fleet Mining command didn't appear.
[*]Fixed a bug where System Map 3D rotation could get stuck.
[*]Fixed a bug where markers would disappear from System Map.
[*]Fixed a bug in Manufacturing views where Queue status was not updated correctly.
[*]Fixed a bug where, on a Station with more than 5 traders, names would disappear when scrolling the list.
[*]Fixed a bug where some tooltips were badly positioned and went out of the screen.
[*]Fixed a bug where a ship could remain stuck when target system server is temporarly unavailable.
[*]Fixed a bug where chat commands were parsed even in the middle of a sentence.
[*]Fixed a bug where Holding Chat was not correcly joined after accepting an invite.
[*]Tutorial: fixed many nasty problems when players simultaneously mine an asteroids, attack a probe or open a cargo.
[*]Tutorial: fixed a problem when trying to open the wrong cargo, like one spawned from another probe killed by someone else.
[*]Tutorial: fixed a problem when disconnecting during a dock command.
[*]Tutorial: fixed a problem where a Reference Box could be moved out of the screen but never moved back in.
[*]Tutorial: fixed a problem where throttle could be activated by mistake in some rare (and rather obscure) situation.
[/list]

Thank you all for your support and patience. 

Sail safe!

notes.title: Client update: 1.0.7
notes.notes:
Today we released a maintenance update. Here is a list of changes:

[list]
[*] changed color of the shield bar (lower left one) from purple to light blue to be coherent with Reference Boxes and navigation markers, and for a better visibility
[*] options in the Option Screen has been reordered, and some old, non-working options has been removed
[*] added two chat options for Navigation Screen chat: persistency and maximum line number
[*] giving an order to an unfitted ship now results in an error
[*] cargo modules for Holding Stations now correctly add 10M cargo space instead of 5M
[*] dev's nicknames in chat are now marked with a 'DEV' icon
[*] fixed a tutorial bug where players might get stuck during first 5 steps
[*] fixed a bug where Reference Boxes moved in chat area would become unclickable
[*] fixed a bug where some pinned Reference Boxes would disappear turning off filters
[*] fixed a bug where the account creation screen could pop up during normal playing
[/list]

We also released a couple of server fixes in the past days:
[list]
[*] fixed a bug where a trader could be stuck after an announce was fulfilled
[*] fixed a bug where the server would crash when someone kicked himself from his Holding
[*] fixed a bug where a system would hang when ships entered through some gates
[/list]

We will release another maintenance update in a few days, to address every reported bugs. Thanks for the patience.

notes.title: Client update 1.0.3/1.0.4
notes.notes:
Today we released two quick maintenance update. Here is the (small) list of changes:

[list]
[*] fixed a bug that prevented some users from login and/or subscribe correctly  through Steam
[*] fixed a bug that prevented bug reporting from client through Steam
[*] fixed a bug that caused a user-created Base Station to be misplaced in the System
[/list]

We're working on some other bugs that we collected until now, and we expect to release some other quick fix in the next days. Main ones are:

[list]
[*] putting a sell order on a Base Station could cause an Agent to be stuck if order is fulfilled, preventing him from embarking on a Ship. - Workaround: put up another order and cancel it.
[*] switching ship when in fleet while traversing a gate can give an obscure error.  and block the client. - Workaround: quit and restart client.
[*] during tutorial, asteroids, probes or wrecks could disappear (destroyed or looted by others, for example) and this, being the filter buttons non-clickable during tutorial, can block the tutorial progression. - Workaround: quit and restart client.
[*] persistency of the chat on Navigation Window seems to be an issue. We're evaluating a quick patch to add a new option slider to change it.
[/list]

Sail safe!
